title: Stack Sorting
desc: Stack Sorting asks you to tidy colorful cylinders into matching stacks before the clock runs out. Move the top cylinder to an empty stack or a matching color, then plan far enough ahead that no piece gets trapped.
howto: Click or tap a stack to lift its top cylinder.
Place it on an empty stack or a matching top color.
Keep at least one useful empty stack available.
Sort every cylinder before the timer ends.
Move from the roomier easy mode into hard mode.
tips: Free a buried color before it locks the whole board.
Leave one emergency space whenever possible.
Sort from the stack causing the largest blockage first.
